canonical_project: Wudang Yungu Big Data Center (武当云谷大数据中心)
owner: Danjiangkou City government / 武当云谷大数据科技有限公司 (SPV)
notes: Located in Danjiangkou city (Shiyan prefecture), Han River right bank big-data industrial park; total investment ~3.5B CNY, planned 5 data-center buildings + 1 support building; uses Danjiangkou reservoir cold water for cooling (green-power + water-cooling model); 开工 reported; Phase 2 (1-B#机电配套, ~8,500 m2) tender published 2026-01-07 on Hubei bidding platform.
